newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Senegal to celebrate Eid al-Fitr on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Senegal to celebrate Eid al-Fitr on Sunday.

text.p: Senegal said on Friday night that Eid Al-Fitr, marking the end of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan, is set for Sunday.

State-run television said it had telephoned nationwide to determine whether anyone had seen the new crescent moon, but to no avail. Therefore Eid has been set for Sunday, and Monday will be a public holiday.
